title: Sadie Jane Ultimate Starter Kit
body_html:
Launching Wednesday, November 25 at 10:00am CST.

Bring effortless elegance to every Mahjong gathering with the Sadie Jane Ultimate Starter Kit. Featuring the romantic beauty of the Sadie Jane Tiles, the fresh floral charm of the Serendipity Mat, and thoughtfully coordinated accessories in soft blush, sky blue, and crisp white, this all-in-one collection has everything you need to play, learn, organize, and travel in style. Complete with premium storage solutions and beginner-friendly resources, it's the perfect setup for seasoned players and those just beginning their Mahjong journey.

What's Included

Sadie Jane Mahjong Tiles

Soft, feminine, and beautifully detailed, the Sadie Jane Mahjong Tiles feature a fresh palette of sky blue, blush pink, soft mint, and crisp white for a look that feels both elegant and playful. Delicate florals bloom across the flower tiles, while graceful bamboo, whimsical dot patterns, and refined character tiles create a balanced, easy-to-read design. Charming illustrations—including sweet birds, playful guardian lions, and beautifully styled Joker tiles—add personality throughout the set. Finished with layered edges in soft blue, blush, and mint, Sadie Jane delivers a fresh, romantic aesthetic that's timeless yet distinctly modern.

Tile Details

• 160 Acrylic Tiles
• Dice/Coin Bag
• 4 Instructional Cards

Tile Breakdown

• 1–9 Bams, Cracks, and Dots (4 of each) = 108
• North, East, West, South Winds (4 of each) = 16
• Red, Green, and White Dragons (4 of each) = 12
• Flowers (not numbered) = 8
• Jokers = 10
• Blanks = 6

Tile Size

• Individual Tile: 0.87" W × 0.6" D × 1.25" H

Serendipity Mahjong Mat

Bright, cheerful, and beautifully balanced, the Serendipity Mahjong Mat features an airy palette of soft sky blue, fresh chartreuse, blush pink, and delicate white florals. Graceful botanical details and layered geometric accents create a fresh, welcoming backdrop that perfectly complements the romantic styling of the Sadie Jane Tiles. The smooth neoprene surface allows tiles to glide effortlessly, while the cushioned backing enhances comfort and reduces noise.

• 33" × 33" neoprene mat
• Cushioned surface for smooth play
• Durable stitched edge
• Instructional layout printed directly on the mat

White Rack & Pusher Set

A clean, timeless rack and pusher set that offers smooth gameplay while perfectly complementing the fresh palette of the Sadie Jane collection.

Metallic Light Blue Tile Storage Bag

Store your tiles beautifully in this structured metallic light blue storage bag, featuring a clear viewing panel and zippered closure for secure, organized storage with a polished finish.

Light Pink Tile Shufflers

Shuffle with ease using this coordinated pair of light pink tile shufflers, designed to simplify setup while adding a soft feminine touch to every game.

4 Light Pink Line Finders

Keep your place with four coordinating light pink line finders that make reading the card quick and effortless.

4 International Mahjong Cards

Four National Mahjong League® compatible instructional cards designed for modern American Mahjong play.

Mahjong 101 Quick Start Guide

Perfect for beginners, the included Mahjong 101 Quick Start Guide helps new players build confidence with simple instructions, gameplay basics, and helpful tips for getting started.

Light Blue Rack Storage  Bag

Keep your racks and pushers neatly organized in this coordinating Light Blue Rack Storage bag. Designed with individual compartments, secure closures, and a convenient carrying handle, it's the perfect travel companion for your Mahjong essentials.

Pink Mat Storage Bag

Carry your Mahjong mat in style with this soft pink canvas mat storage bag. Spacious, durable, and easy to carry, it provides a beautiful way to transport and protect your mat between games.

✨ Why You'll Love It

The Sadie Jane Ultimate Starter Kit combines graceful florals, soft pastel hues, and beautifully coordinated accessories into one thoughtfully curated collection. From the premium storage solutions to the beginner-friendly Mahjong 101 Quick Start Guide, every detail is designed to make learning, traveling, and playing effortless. Whether you're hosting game night, gifting a future Mahjong enthusiast, or elevating your own collection, this complete set brings beauty, function, and timeless style to every hand.
